title: Duplicate skill across JD tiers, long resume
purpose: The job description lists Docker twice, under Required and again under Bonus, and mentions two further skills in an intro sentence with ambiguous tier. Tests duplicate handling (one entry, most demanding tier) and ambiguous-tier reporting. Eight distinct canonical skills, nine JD mentions.
length_note: Measured at 1094 characters; chunk placement unverified.

inputs.job_description:
Backend Engineer - Quarry Platform Team (synthetic)

Candidates with experience with Apache Kafka or Kubernetes will be considered favourably.

Required:
- Java development for backend services.
- Spring Boot for building REST APIs.
- PostgreSQL for relational data storage.
- Redis for caching.
- Containerization with Docker.

Preferred:
- Cloud deployment experience on AWS.

Bonus:
- Docker image size optimisation.
inputs.resume_text:
SYNTHETIC CANDIDATE FOUR
Backend Engineer

EXPERIENCE
Backend Engineer, Quarry Payments (synthetic) | 2020-2024
- Developed 8 REST services in Java with Spring Boot for a payment reconciliation platform.
- Designed PostgreSQL schemas for 15 tables and tuned 6 slow queries, cutting average response time from 800 ms to 200 ms.
- Wrote integration tests for Spring Boot controllers and raised test coverage from 55% to 78%.
- Deployed one service to an AWS EC2 instance by following a team runbook.
- Participated in on-call rotation for 4 services.

Software Engineer, Tidewater Systems (synthetic) | 2017-2020
- Built batch jobs in Java that processed invoices for 200 customers.
- Migrated reporting queries to PostgreSQL from spreadsheets, removing 10 hours of manual work each month.
- Reviewed pull requests for a team of 5 engineers.

PROJECTS
Library Catalog API | 2021
- Built a Spring Boot API with PostgreSQL and 40 automated tests.

SKILLS
Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, JUnit, Maven, Git

EDUCATION
B.E. in Computer Engineering, Example College of Engineering | 2013-2017
